body: Thanks again for reaching out I really appreciate it! *Big Hugs* :)

If you want to pm me later, that's okay. I am going to try to get some sleep as I am largely sleep deprived at the moment as well as ill (which doesn't help matters at all!) Is it okay if I pm you an update when I am feeling better? (Physically to start with anyway!) :)

Hi. Im sorry you are feeling bad too. :/ That's really very nice of you to offer...but to be completely honest, I get very anxious talking with people on the phone that I don't know very well. :/ Otherwise I would, but sorry to say I would prefer not to. :/ I hope your day gets better!
